name: Input
summary: Native single-line text input with form semantics, visible labeling, optional supporting feedback, validation variants, and independent passive icon slots.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Wrapper that groups the visible label, native field, optional icon composition, and supporting message.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.description: Visible label associated with the form control.

anatomy.name: requiredIndicator
anatomy.description: Decorative asterisk optically centered with the label when the field is required.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.description: Positioning wrapper used when the field includes a leading or trailing icon.

anatomy.name: leadingIcon
anatomy.description: Optional passive icon positioned before the field value.

anatomy.name: trailingIcon
anatomy.description: Optional passive icon positioned after the field value.

variants.name: warning
variants.description: Validation warning state for values that need attention without being invalid.

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer hover state on the native field; validation variants retain their semantic border family.

states.name: focusVisible
states.description: Keyboard focus indicator on the native field.

states.name: readOnly
states.description: Focusable native state whose value can be selected and submitted but not edited.

behavior.name: labelAssociation
behavior.description: The visible label and native field share an explicit for/id association so the label is the field's accessible name and activates the field.

behavior.name: messageAssociation
behavior.description: When supporting or validation text is present, the native field references that message through aria-describedby.

behavior.name: errorSemantics
attributes: role="alert" on a dynamically presented error message
behavior.description: The error class provides visual treatment only. The native field also exposes aria-invalid, and a newly presented error message may use alert semantics.

behavior.name: nativeDisabled
behavior.description: Unavailable fields use the native disabled attribute, which supplies form and focus behavior in addition to the visual disabled state.

behavior.name: nativeValueOwnership
attributes: value content attribute establishes the initial HTML value
value IDL property represents the live value
behavior.description: Static HTML remains natively uncontrolled after its initial value. Framework adapters may bind the live value property and native events for controlled use without introducing a second value owner.

behavior.name: nativeFormSemantics
behavior.description: Stable single-line form semantics stay on the sole native input owner; visual required communication remains author content in the visible label or associated instructions.

behavior.name: passiveIconComposition
behavior.description: Leading and trailing icons are independent passive slots and may coexist. Interactive field actions belong to specialized components instead of these slots.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Visible label associated with the native field.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Current text value of the native field.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Native form field name used to identify the submitted value.

properties.name: required
properties.description: Participates in native required-value constraint validation and shows the standardized decorative marker beside the visible label.

properties.name: readOnly
properties.description: Prevents native editing while preserving focus, selection, and form submission.

properties.name: autocomplete
properties.description: Native autofill hint, including standard autocomplete tokens and optional section or address-group prefixes.

properties.name: minLength
properties.description: Optional native minimum character length used by constraint validation.

properties.name: maxLength
properties.description: Optional native maximum character length accepted by the field.

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: Optional supporting hint shown when the native field is empty; it does not replace the visible label.

properties.name: message
properties.description: Optional supporting or validation message associated with the native field.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Validation presentation selected from the canonical variant list; default is the contract default.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Makes the native field unavailable through its disabled attribute.

properties.name: leadingIcon
properties.description: Optional passive icon before the field value. It can coexist with trailingIcon.

properties.name: trailingIcon
properties.description: Optional passive icon after the field value. It can coexist with leadingIcon.

accessibility: Associate every input field with a visible label using matching for/id attributes or an equivalent accessible name.
Use aria-describedby to connect supporting or validation messages to the input when messages are present.
Use aria-invalid="true" for error states; do not apply aria-invalid for success or warning.
Use native required, readonly, disabled, autocomplete, minlength, and maxlength semantics instead of recreating them with ARIA or script.
Communicate a required field visibly in the label or associated instructions; the native required attribute alone is not a visual instruction.
Use readOnly when a value remains focusable, selectable, and submittable; use disabled only when the field is unavailable.
Do not rely on icon color alone to communicate validation status.
Treat leading and trailing icon slots as decorative or status cues; use a specialized component for interactive field actions.

web.notes: Canonical CSS styles the native input; static HTML is uncontrolled after its initial value while adapters may bind the live value property and native events.

shopify.notes: Shopify Liquid can render labels, native input elements, form attributes, and validation messages with the same class contract.

react.notes: A future adapter maps controlled value/onInput or an uncontrolled initial value to the same native input owner.
